objective: Test whether a fixed light training-side AST-fbank augmentation or per-outer-fold nested policy selection improves the tuned frozen-AST animal-level age classifier.

relationship.idea058_strict: completed reference-stage evidence; top-block stabilization paused
relationship.idea056: defines the tuned frozen-AST head and animal-level validation cross-entropy checkpoint rule
relationship.stage: active independent performance route after IDEA-058 strict closeout

dataset.input: locked normalized 128-frame by 128-bin AST filterbank segments
dataset.call_representation: arithmetic mean of AST pooler outputs across segments belonging to one call
dataset.animal_aggregation: arithmetic mean of call probabilities belonging to one cat

augmentation.unit: one stochastic view per original call per epoch
augmentation.view_budget: one call remains one optimizer example; batch count and optimizer-step count match the reference
augmentation.valid_region: operations affect real fbank frames only; padding remains bitwise unchanged

P1_specaugment_light.description: at most one narrow time mask and one narrow frequency mask

P2_gain_noise_light.description: small normalized log-fbank offset plus small Gaussian perturbation

P3_shift_combo_light.description: small circular shift inside the valid time region plus reduced gain jitter

augmentation.seed_derivation: outer_stream_seed_base + repeat*10000 + outer_fold*100; segment views additionally hash epoch, call index, and segment ordinal

inner_selection.selection_rule: within each repeat-by-outer-fold boundary, rank candidate policies by mean animal Macro F1 across three paired augmentation streams; ties within 1e-6 use lower mean animal cross-entropy, lower severity rank, then lexical policy ID
inner_selection.selected_epoch_rule: median of the three best epochs for the selected policy
inner_selection.stream_stability_rule: the selected policy must rank in the top two for at least two of three streams

C0_online_identity.input: locked fbank passed through online frozen AST

A1_fixed_specaugment.input: training fbank passed through online frozen AST

A2_nested_policy.input: training fbank passed through online frozen AST

fixed_training.encoder: fully frozen and held in evaluation mode
fixed_training.frozen_encoder_execution: encode each epoch's augmented calls in deterministic batches of 32, then preserve the original 8-call head batches, BatchNorm behavior, dropout stream, weights, and optimizer-step count
fixed_training.head: 768 -> 128 -> 3 with ReLU, BatchNorm and dropout
fixed_training.epoch_selection: minimum unweighted current-fold inner-validation animal-level cross-entropy
fixed_training.call_weighting: fixed global class-balanced call weights from the current training role
fixed_training.normalization: mean and standard deviation of locked frozen AST embeddings from current training calls

requirements: all stochastic policies are deterministic for the same stream and change for a different stream
one-view batch and optimizer-step counts match R0
online identity AST embeddings agree with the locked cache within 3e-5
all augmented calls inherit the original cat_id and training role

bootstrap.method: paired cat-cluster bootstrap for R0-C0, R0-A1, R0-A2, and A1-A2 contrasts

seed_expansion_gate.action_when_A1_met: authorize seeds 43 and 101 for the fixed light augmentation
seed_expansion_gate.action_when_A2_met: authorize seeds 43 and 101 for the nested-selected augmentation policy
seed_expansion_gate.action_when_unmet: close the current finite augmentation pool and retain the complete negative or mixed result
